black_ice.name: Black ice / refreeze
black_ice.verified_against: RWIS surface condition reports ice / black ice

flash_freeze.name: Flash freeze
flash_freeze.verified_against: RWIS condition changes from wet to ice within 3 h

wheel_track_glazing.name: Wheel-track glazing
wheel_track_glazing.verified_against: RWIS surface condition reports ice or snow (crash/traffic-speed data not available)

bridges_first.name: Bridges first
bridges_first.verified_against: Observed bridge road temp at or below 32F while its paired road site is above 32F

freezing_rain.name: Freezing rain
freezing_rain.verified_against: RWIS surface condition reports ice (precipitation type is not observed)

not_verified.Salt struggles: Qualitative rule: there is no RWIS measurement to check it against.

definitions.hit_rate: Of the times the hazard was observed, the share that had the flag on (higher is better).
definitions.false_alarm_ratio: Of the times the flag was on, the share where the hazard was not observed (lower is better).
definitions.false_alarm_rate: Of the times the hazard was not observed, the share where the flag was on (lower is better).
